setlist.title: Beat It On Down The Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Help On The Way** (2 reviews): The reviewer's one clear memory is the second-set opening Help On The Way; Reviewer recalls incredible guitar playing through the Help, Slipknot and Franklin's Tower sequence [18][20]
- **Friend of the Devil** (1 review): Reviewer praises a nice jam in Friend of the Devil [22]
- **Beat It On Down The Line** (1 other source): Brent can be heard scat singing about 4:07 into Beat It On Down The Line [4]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Reviewer notes Estimated Prophet has some nice solos and jams [24]

## The recordings

- **gd84-07-04.sbd.miller.27761.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 166 min; rated 4.17/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Healy ran the reverb so high that the pre-show sound resembled a burning fuse, per the reviewer [29]
- **gd1984-07-04.sbd.miller.bertha.27862.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 166 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Tape flutter and speed problems from machine trouble in the source are audible throughout the show [2]
- **gd1984-07-04.senn421.carpenter.andrewf.87341.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 164 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1984-07-04.150315.beyerm88.holbrook.flac2448**: source not stated; 22 songs; 166 min [4]
- **gd84-07-04.senn421.braverman.14194.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 162 min; rated 4.53/5 by 17 [10]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the jamming and recording quality both good and worth downloading; Reviewer says the sound quality is not great [18][22]

## Around the show

- During the set break, reviewer saw Phil near the stage taking a big hit from a joint [21]
- Reviewer thinks Phil dedicated a song to Paul and the Rainbow Bus, rather than Bobby doing so [22]
- Reviewer believes Paul was killed in Indianapolis days earlier, hit by a car stepping into the street [25]
- On the drive to Cedar Rapids for the reviewer's first Dead show, Doug spilled red wine in the car [25]
- Police drove up and down the street outside, arresting people; a friend was busted for drinking a beer there [26]
- Reviewer says Paul died on the way to the show when a bus crashed outside St. Louis [27]
- Reviewer saw the tour from Kingswood in Canada to Richmond; this crowd had unusually many locals and few East Coast fans [28]
- Reviewer recalls the downtown Cedar Rapids Hilton was unprepared for fans, with LSD sheets floating in its indoor pool [29]
- Reviewer rates it a solid, slightly above-average mid-eighties show, neither a top-ten best nor worst [18]
- Reviewer, who attended the whole tour, calls it one of the most solid shows of that tour [21]
- Reviewer ranks this show near the top of the tour, apart from the July 13 Dark Star [28]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd84-07-04.sbd.miller.27761.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> Master Cassette> Cassette> Dat, plus patches from FOB Sennheiser 421> Cass [1]. Also: Charlie Miller transferred and patched it, correcting speed by +2.37% to match the FOB source [1]
- **gd1984-07-04.sbd.miller.bertha.27862.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: Bertha Remaster of the Master Cassette/Cassette source [2]. Also: Remastered on January 19, 2005 using a dual-DAW setup nicknamed Bertha, with light noise reduction applied first [2]
- **gd1984-07-04.senn421.carpenter.andrewf.87341.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ted Carpenter; transferred by Andrew F; source: Sennheiser MD-421's > patched thru one deck (D5?) > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell XL-II's, with no Dolby. Mics on stand set up FOB [3]. Also: ShnID-14194 supplies patches, including all of Feel Like a Stranger, Don't Ease Me In, Good Lovin' and U.S. Blues; Levels, fades and patches were done in Soundforge; the second-set disc break is seamless [3]
- **gd1984-07-04.150315.beyerm88.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Executive Crew - Tom Pinney, Sean Murtha; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: MAUD CA: Beyer M88's XY > Sony TCD5M|s1 Maxell UDXLIIS 90; s2 Maxell MX90 no NR, 2nd deck in line Location: 80 feet from stage DFC 7 feet up [4]. Also: This recording has cuts where tape decks were flipped, including a quick mid-tape cut possibly missing seven seconds [4]
- **gd84-07-04.senn421.braverman.14194.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD: MC (Sennheiser 421)> DAT> CD> SHN [10]
